profile.headline: Software Development, Analytics, & Marketing Consultant
profile.summary:
Aspiring software engineer with deep experience in big data analysis, digital marketing, and consulting. Former Measurement / Analytics Lead at Google for a $200M+ book of business.

See some of my work at github.com/anthnyalxndr.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
• Unlocking profitable growth for SMBs through marketing, analytics, and software consulting services.
• Implementing analytics-measurement and telemetry solutions to establish a foundation for data-driven decision-making.
• Leveraging experimentation and data-driven insights to optimize marketing campaigns and business operations.
• Developing and implementing custom software solutions to automate business processes and drive growth.
